notes.title: Limited Time Edition for Halloween!
notes.notes: In the spirit of Halloween we are releasing a special [b]Halloween edition[/b] of our game that will only be available for two weeks Starting October 29th.

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Updates
notes.notes:
The Pulse Studio development team is committed to supporting our users. And one way of doing that is by adding features and squashing bugs! 

We have released a new version of Escape Black Orion VR with several updates, new features, and killed bugs.

Remember, if you have any issues in the game that we should know about, please contact us! We're excited to maintain our Escape Black Orion VR series. 

Good luck opening that door! And keep an eye out for Episode II 

[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Oculus Users can now take advantage of the Oculus Store communicating with the game. This includes checking if the HMD is on and if not, (or if the sensors lose you, or if you enter the Oculus menu), the game will pause so you don't lose time.
[*] Buttons get accidentally pressed, that's why we added a confirmation screen to the menu for certain options such as 'Restart Game'.
[/list]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] The team has released [b]8 achievements[/b] to be earned in your attempt to escape! Good luck.

[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] All achievements are now open and ready to be earned throughout the game.
[*] Several Pipes in the Pipe maze were mistakenly causing a fail on some devices. 
[*] Main Menu and In-Game menu pausing was have an effect on the controller input. Some users were unable to continue.
[*]Controller input issues. We have now separated the input by device profiles. So Oculus and Vive users can play with input that makes sense to them. 

[/list]


Until next time!
